india.one_line: India sees defence AI partnership, massive AI infrastructure funding, and Freshworks bolstering incident‑management AI.

themes.title: Defence ministry partners with Sarvam AI
themes.text: Sarvam AI signed a five‑year MoU with the Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff to develop and deploy AI for operational, training and decision‑support across the Army, Navy and Air Force.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI signs five‑year MoU with Indian defence to develop AI applications

themes.title: AM Intelligence seeks $3 billion
themes.text: Indian AI infrastructure firm AM Intelligence is looking to raise up to $3 billion, including bonds, loans and a $300 million advance, to finance its purchase of Nvidia’s Vera Rubin systems.

stories.headline: AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase

themes.title: Freshworks adds incident‑investigation AI
themes.text: Freshworks acquired Israel AI startup Robusta Dev, integrating AI‑driven outage diagnosis and remediation into its Freshservice IT service‑management platform.

stories.headline: Freshworks acquires Israel AI startup Robusta Dev to add incident‑investigation AI to Freshservice
Freshworks acquires Israel AI startup Robusta Dev to boost incident management
